features.title: Everything about your money, in one app.

items.title: Dashboard
items.description: Net worth, trends, and upcoming bills at a glance.

items.title: Records
items.description: Fast entry, voice input, receipt photos, calendar view.

items.title: Accounts
items.description: Checking, savings, cards, cash — in any currency.

items.title: Investments
items.description: Live quotes, portfolio allocation, per-holding history.

items.title: Budgets
items.description: Monthly budgets per category with pacing and transfers.

items.title: AI Advisor
items.description: Bring your own Anthropic or OpenAI key for on-device insights.

whatsNew.title: Small things that make it feel like yours.
whatsNew.subhead: This release is about the everyday: saving toward something, logging faster, and seeing your numbers without opening the app.

items.title: Savings goals
items.description: Set a target and a date. Track progress from linked account balances or a manual log, and see how much you need to put aside each month.

items.title: Dark mode
items.description: A carefully tuned dark theme across every screen. Follow the system, or choose Light or Dark yourself.

items.title: Share to capture
items.description: Share a receipt photo, a message, or a CSV/XLSX statement into MoneyWise from any app. It becomes a record — or opens the importer.

items.title: Home & Lock Screen widgets
items.description: Today's spending and your budget at a glance, on the iPhone Home and Lock Screen and on Android home screens.

duo.subhead: On a foldable iPhone, MoneyWise opens into a true two-pane layout — the list on one side, the details on the other, and nothing important on the crease.

bullets.title: Two panes in book pose
bullets.description: Accounts and Activity show the list beside the detail, so you can scan and inspect without tapping back and forth.

bullets.title: Designed around the crease
bullets.description: No controls sit on the fold. A slim tab rail moves into the status strip so your content gets the full width.

bullets.title: Half-open, too
bullets.description: Prop it up in laptop pose and the tab bar stays put, with a comfortable reading width for long lists.

duo.alt: MoneyWise on a foldable iPhone, showing records and the dashboard side by side

watch.subhead: Check what's left to spend and log an expense in seconds — without reaching for your phone.

bullets.title: Left to spend, at a glance
bullets.description: Today's spending, how much of this month's budget is used, and your five most recent transactions.

bullets.title: Quick add
bullets.description: Enter an amount with the keypad or the Digital Crown, pick a category and account, done. Entries made away from your iPhone sync when it's back in range.

bullets.title: Complications
bullets.description: Put free-to-spend, today's spending, or a one-tap Add button right on your watch face.

watch.alt_primary: MoneyWise on Apple Watch showing what's left to spend this month
watch.alt_secondary: MoneyWise on Apple Watch showing the monthly budget ring

extensions.title_part1: Bring your own AI. Wire MoneyWise into your
extensions.subhead: An OAuth-protected MCP server lets Claude, Cursor and any MCP-compatible assistant read your accounts and transactions. Bring your own API keys — your data and your spend stay yours.

pillars.title: MCP server
pillars.description: An OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol endpoint exposes accounts, transactions and net worth as structured tools your AI assistant can call.

pillars.title: Bring your own key
pillars.description: Plug in Anthropic, OpenAI or other API keys for the in-app AI Advisor and Daily Brief. Keys live in the system keychain — never our servers.

pillars.title: Tested with the assistants you use
pillars.description: Claude Desktop and Cursor work out of the box. Any MCP-compatible client can connect with one paste of the server URL.

privacyFirst.title: Your data stays on your phone.
privacyFirst.subhead: MoneyWise is built local-first. No ads, no trackers, no data sale — ever.

pillars.title: Offline-first
pillars.description: Every record is stored locally in an encrypted SQLite database. Works with airplane mode on.

pillars.title: Optional cloud sync
pillars.description: Sync across your own devices when you turn it on. Rows are encrypted at rest; we can't read them.

pillars.title: BYOK AI
pillars.description: Bring your own Anthropic or OpenAI key. Keys live in the iOS keychain and never transit our servers.

featuresPage.title: Every feature, in plain English.
featuresPage.subhead: MoneyWise covers everyday tracking and serious analysis. Here's what's inside.

modules.title: Dashboard
modules.description: The first thing you see every morning. Total net worth, daily spending, upcoming bills, and a mini trend for every account.

modules.title: Records
modules.description: Fast entry for expenses, income, and transfers. Group by day, attach photos, set recurrence, and review pending items in one tap.
bullets: Voice input with automatic category detection

modules.title: Budgets
modules.description: Set monthly budgets per category. Pacing tells you if you're spending too fast. Transfer between categories when life changes.
bullets: Pacing indicator vs. same period last month

modules.title: Investments
modules.description: Live prices for stocks and crypto. Portfolio allocation donut, per-holding history, and AI insights on your positions.

modules.title: AI Advisor
modules.description: Bring your own Anthropic or OpenAI key. The advisor reads your (local) data and answers questions — nothing leaves your device unless you ask.
bullets: Works with Anthropic Claude or OpenAI

modules.title: Security
modules.description: Face ID / Touch ID lock. All data encrypted at rest. Optional cloud sync uses end-to-end encrypted rows — we can't read them.
